budget.rationale: two development geometries, eight fresh validation worlds and one fixed library seed; reuse exact duplicate trials; 148 maximum rather than another 384-episode benchmark

compute: paced contention and immutable publication test; reserve unchanged
diagnostics.equal_size_control: F2_2K uses distinct immutable F2 and DR policies; duplicated frozen rows are not a repertoire expansion
executed_commands: authenticate actual applied motor commands against separate application log
selected policy, eligible set, QP row/bound and held-check outcome
motor state and current-effectiveness actual force
never substitute a candidate rollout for the executed command
diagnostics.feasibility: failed hover trim or missing local witness does not prove every flight maneuver impossible
learner: Adam momentum inherited versus reset diagnostic
diagnostics.obstacle_free: use competent identical states first under no change and effectiveness-only; development/validation states remain separate
repertoire: all skills at common saved physical state, model and obstacle prediction
frozen/adapted/union hard and smooth policy values
coupled allocation and feasible maneuver witnesses
diagnostics.union: pointwise max over immutable frozen plus adapted skills cannot decrease frozen coverage at identical inputs; no closed-loop guarantee

phase_order: nominal PD validation and fixed development comparison

historical_development_anchor.role: development diagnosis only; not a held-out confirmation

physical_spec.initial_motor_rule: nominal level-hover effort, retained at every fault

world.case_study_time_convention: all obstacle and dynamics queries use absolute time

ego_enclosure.scope: body-origin spherical safety envelope; envelope intersection is distinct from a measured MuJoCo collider contact

world.event_semantics: right-continuous prescribed changes at command boundaries
world.incoming_motion_scope: globally bounded analytic passage; obstacle may originate outside ego arena
world.obstacle_masks: all obstacles active at all prediction nodes; no teleports

historical_development_anchor.selection_rule: minimum (old world_index, library_seed) among A-collision/F2-clear structured-effectiveness trials

lead_time_definition.also_record: first prescribed incoming-obstacle zero-crossing time minus fault onset; pre-threat published-update count
lead_time_definition.qualification: physical pre-fault histories differ across lead cells; exact common history is required only within each freeze/continue pair
lead_time_definition.rule: advance only the fault onset; preserve absolute obstacle paths, initial conditions, task, nominal controller and physical bounds

matched_history_contract.comparison_cut: immediately before the first control/learning operation at fault time; event and observation ordering identical
matched_history_contract.freeze_rule: same adaptive runtime method and full startup checkpoint in both arms; freeze_learning_at equals fault time only in frozen arm
matched_history_contract.prefix_reexecution: allowed only if every saved numerical prefix array and complete fault checkpoint match; otherwise pair is inadmissible

numerical_robustness.promoted_result: must additionally pass the same fixed subprotocol on its validation world; this requires an explicit bounded amendment if not already the anchor

fresh_build_1.compilation_cache: new empty directory in a fresh process

fresh_build_2.compilation_cache: another new empty directory in a fresh process

numerical_robustness.report: retain every physical outcome, command divergence and margin; any category change flags numerical fragility
numerical_robustness.selection: fixed historical harmful geometry; no best-case or cache selection

outcome_definition.missing: unresolved, error, interrupted, unmatched prefix, or missing command evidence stays incomplete; never count as success or failure
outcome_definition.success: safe_task_completion: all waypoints, no collider contact, no physical operational violation, full common-duration exposure

proposal.prior_study_policy: read only; retain its splits, outcomes, archive, report and conclusions unchanged

selection.inference: two prespecified within-world contrasts, one library seed; descriptive world-level evidence, not broad population superiority
selection.validation_changes: retain all attempts; an amendment needs a new envelope and a genuinely new validation set
selection.validation_opening: after nominal PD validation and repair choice/source/checkpoints are bound; no tuning after validation outcomes
